title: Scheduled jobs
cronHint: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday. Supports *, /, - and commas.
previewHint: Preview uses this expression. Automatic execution requires saving and enabling the job.
timeoutHint: Timeout limits each database statement. Disabling cancels retries; manual runs remain available.
noMatch: No matching jobs. Adjust your search or status filter.
registeredHint: Jobs are registered in backend code. Configure schedules, status and retry policies here.
runDescription: Run “{{name}}” now using its saved configuration without changing its normal schedule. The outcome will appear in execution logs.
discardDescription: Your changes have not been saved. Leaving or reloading will discard them.

errors.conflict: Configuration changed elsewhere. Refresh the page before editing again. Your draft has been kept.
errors.busy: The job is running. Try again shortly.
errors.notFound: This job does not exist or is no longer registered.
errors.denied: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.invalid: Invalid configuration. Check the five cron fields, possible dates and numeric ranges.
errors.failed: Request failed. Check your connection and try again.
